| [GET](#get-metrics-status) | `/v1/metrics/status` | Get the local metrics storage status of cluster nodes |

sections.title: Get metrics status
sections.text:
GET /v1/metrics/status

Get the status of all nodes or a specific node. The response describes the state of each node's store. It doesn't return the stored metrics.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_cluster_info](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_cluster_info) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/metrics/status?node_uid=1

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

#### Query parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| node_uid | integer | Optional. The ID of the node to get the status of. If omitted, returns the status of all nodes. |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns a `nodes` array with one object for each node in scope. #### Example JSON body [code example] #### Node status fields | Field | Type | Description | |-------|------|-------------| | uid | string | The node ID | | state | string | State of the node's metrics store:
`running`
`stopped`
`unknown` | | disk_usage_bytes | integer | Disk space used by stored metrics, in bytes | | disk_max_bytes | integer | Configured maximum disk space for stored metrics, in bytes, set by [`local_storage_max_size_mb`](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/metrics_config) | | retention_days_configured | integer | Configured retention, in days, set by [`local_storage_retention_days`](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/metrics_config) | | retention_days_effective | integer | Retention currently in effect on the node, in days. It matches `retention_days_configured` unless the node has been under [storage pressure](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/monitoring/metrics_stream_engine/local-metrics-storage#storage-pressure-retention), which lowers effective retention to keep stored data within `disk_max_bytes`. When the two values differ, the node keeps less history than configured. | | data_range | object | Time range covered by the node's stored samples, with `from` and `to` timestamps | | health | string | Health of the node's metrics store:
`ok`
`degraded`
`unknown` |

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | Success. |
| [404 Not Found](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.5) | The `node_uid` doesn't match a node in the cluster (`error_code`: `node_not_found`). |
| [500 Internal Server Error](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.5.1) | Internal server error. |
